LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Vertical card that displays a related record (the Account of a Contact/Case/Opp, or the primary Contact of an Account). Picks the counterpart automatically from the record's object type. Bilingual EN / FR. Industry-agnostic defaults.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'en' or 'fr' (default). Controls card title, button labels and empty state.

property.name: target
property.label: What to display
property.description: 'auto' (default) picks the natural counterpart: on Account → primary Contact; on Contact/Case/Opportunity/Order → the linked Account. 'account' and 'contact' force a specific target.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the target default ('Account'/'Compte' or 'Primary Contact'/'Contact principal').

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card icon (override)
property.description: SLDS icon name. Leave empty for the target default (standard:account or standard:contact).

property.name: fieldsCsv
property.label: Fields to display (API names, comma-separated)
property.description: Leave empty for sensible defaults. Contact default: 'Title,Department,Email,Phone,MobilePhone'. Account default: 'Industry,Type,Phone,Website,AnnualRevenue,NumberOfEmployees'. Fields unknown to the target are silently skipped.

property.name: contactImageFieldApiName
property.label: Contact image field API name
property.description: URL field on Contact used as the image source when the displayed target is Contact. Schema-safe: skipped if the field is absent. Falls back to a File attached to the contact when empty.

property.name: accountImageFieldApiName
property.label: Account image field API name
property.description: Optional URL field on Account. Empty by default - the card uses the File attached to the account as the image source.

property.name: disableImageReplace
property.label: Disable click-to-replace image
property.description: Off by default - clicking the avatar opens a file picker and uploads the new image as a File on the target (same convention as Record Highlights). Turn ON to lock the avatar.
